text_block_list.text:
While eagerly awaiting her showdown
with Eishin
Flash in the Arima Kinen,
Голд Шип
suddenly—like, alarmingly
suddenly―discovers
the power of
beauty!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп plans to take over the world
with her
beauty, but when the avatar of
beauty T.M.
Opera O overhears this, she
simply cannot let it
slide!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Two elegant auras clash with enough
intensity to
make anyone nauseous, in a
battle through which
beauty standards
may not survive. Neither side
yields...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the end, they acknowledge each
other as
worthy foes. The beauty of
Голд Шип and T.M.
Opera O's friendship
is beyond words... Their
battle ends in a
draw!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
